title: Build revised realistic 500 sqft cafeteria
objective: Generate, import, cook, and validate a revised small cafeteria world that fixes the user's visual complaints: real windows, real indoor lights, chair orientation, reduced cartoony style, and better active-light behavior.
instructions: Run all long jobs in a named tmux session and preserve the tmux session/logs for user monitoring.

Use Scout result .control-tower/packets/inbox/scout-cafeteria-lighting-quality-diagnosis-result.json and Builder result .control-tower/packets/inbox/builder-flashlight-indirect-light-controls-result.json as context.

Create a new revision rather than replacing the existing map: source/provenance under /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and SPEAR map /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 unless a hard technical blocker requires another name.

Scene requirements: approximately 500 sqft, actual wall openings for windows rather than glass patches on a solid wall, visible exterior or daylight context beyond windows, indoor ceiling/wall light fixtures, neutral/desaturated realistic material palette, less toy-like geometry/proportions, chairs visually facing toward tables, and no highly saturated large surfaces directly in common flashlight paths.

Because the current FBX import path does not preserve Blender area lights as Unreal lights, add or preserve real Unreal light actors during/after import. Validate they exist in the imported map and document how they interact with --disable-scene-lights.
Prefer collision enabled or add simple collision/blocking enough for teleop validation; do not import with --no-auto-generate-collision unless you explicitly record why.
Cook/package the revised map into the standalone game build if feasible.

Run a lightweight validation command or scripted check, not a long manual session: confirm import/cook success, static mesh count, map path, light actor/component count if possible, and provide a recommended user run command using the new --indirect-lighting-intensity default/control.
constraints: Do not modify product code unless absolutely necessary; if product code changes are needed, stop and report a Builder handoff recommendation instead.
Keep generated artifacts organized under a timestamped .control-tower/runs directory.

artifacts: examples/flashlight/run.py and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py now expose --indirect-lighting-intensity for spawned co-located ASpotLight flashlights, defaulting to 0.0 to avoid room-wide color bounce in small saturated interiors.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with tmux session name, run directory, source .blend path, generator script path, FBX path, SPEAR map path, changed/created asset directories, import/cook status, warnings, and exact user run command.
Clear note on whether real Unreal indoor lights were added and how to run with or without scene lights.
definition_of_done: A revised cafeteria map is cooked and ready for user visual validation, or a blocked result explains the exact blocker and preserves logs.
